'''Jarea Kaela''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] active during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biography==
A Force-sensitive [[Quermian/Legends|Quermian]], Jarea Kaela was a [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] who used her connection to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Animal bond|bond]] with a [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]] she called [[Hassi/Legends|Hassi]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] Kaela had attracted the attention of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], a guild of hunters intent on capturing or destroying Forceful individuals. Fleeing her home to protect those around her, she was tracked from world to world by agents of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The first [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] took her unawares, which cost her the use of her eyes. Successfully killing each successive attacker with her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Kaela moved from world to world in a heavy robe and signature wide-brimmed hat, gaining a reputation as a witch of great power and evil.

Hiding in the swamps of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karalle/Legends|Karalle]], Kaela used a mannequin of herself to distract her latest hunter, [[Harlon Gier/Legends|Harlon Gier]]. Catching Gier by surprise after he thought he had killed her, Kaela demanded to know why Gier wished her dead. While Gier initially hoped to outsmart her because of her blindness, he was seduced by her kindness, and her offer to train him. He only agreed to be trained by the saber-wielder when his employer, an Imperial [[Unidentified Inquisitor (Karalle)/Legends|Inquisitor]], stepped out of the forest with a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] ready to kill them both. Recognizing his fate lay in the hands of Kaela, Gier raised his blaster and opened fire on the Imperials
